outcome: effectiveness of blood processing (erythrocyte recovery, volume processed, cell concentrate yield, a-fetoprotein reduction)
safety (bacterial contamination, amniotic fluid contamination, cellular, protein, electrolyte, and metabolic parameters, blood coagulation)
cohort: The study included 20 adult women undergoing cesarean section at Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital, Bloemfontein.
finding: The HemoClear system was found to be adaptable, safe, and efficient for intraoperative use during cesarean sections in obstetric hemorrhage cases in a resource-constrained environment.
mod_finding: The HemoClear system demonstrated safety and efficiency for intraoperative use during cesarean sections, particularly in obstetric hemorrhage cases.
